title: Native braided model and unit squares from monoidal factorization
statement: Given the braided cochain restriction c with its inverse tensorator and unit equations, and a braided derived restriction d whose canonical factorization is monoidal for the native localization structures, the native K-flat model normalization square and the canonical unit equation hold for d. This cancellation statement assumes the K-flat and flat-term hypotheses in the ModelNormalization interface only through its conclusion and asserts no existence of d.

proof.text: Install the given braided structures and native lax braided localization structures. On P,Q and their restricted images use RingedDerivedNative.isIso_mu with hP and hiP. Apply the proved private generic inverse_tensor_square_aux, which cancels the three tensorators in NatTrans.IsMonoidal.tensor. Replace the cochain inverse tensorator with hcδ. Identify the native tensorIso maps with inverse tensorators and the derived braidedComparison with the inverse derived tensorator. Naturality of factors along the identity identification of coefficientTotalTensor with the native tensor aligns their displayed components. This proves every ModelNormalization square; neither flat-term hypotheses nor the second K-flat hypothesis is needed for cancellation.

Apply the proved clopen_braided_unit_square to h, c, hcη, d and the given monoidal factorization. This proves the canonical unit equation independently of the tensor computation. Combine it with the ModelNormalization square from step 1.

theorem clopen_braided_model_squares
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (h : (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided)
    (b : coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t} (topology X) R ⋙
        clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R ≅
      ((clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).prod
        (clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R)) ⋙
          coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t} (topology Y)
            ((clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R))
    (c : (clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided)
    (hcδ : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) ℤ,
      c.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.δ P Q = b.hom.app (P, Q))
    (hcη : c.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.η =
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R) (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).app
          (𝟙_ (clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R))).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).map
          (clopenTensorUnitComparison.{t, u} j R h).hom)
    (d : (derivedRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided) :
    letI := c
    letI := d
    letI := RingedDerivedNative.laxBraided.{t + 1, t, u, max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (topology X) R
    letI := RingedDerivedNative.laxBraided.{t + 1, t, u, max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (topology Y) ((clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R)
    NatTrans.IsMonoidal (factors.{t, u} j R).hom →
      ModelNormalization.{t, u} j R b (braidedComparison.{t, u} j R d) ∧
        braidedUnit.{t, u} j R d = unitComparison.{t, u} j R h
